body:
LAN REWIRING PLAN — Mythical Network Model

Principle: Every swap gives new info. Re-plan at every 3rd step.

CURRENT STATE (measured 2026-11-05 Wave 222):
  3x 10G gates: eastGate, southGate, ironGate
  1x 2.5G gate: sporeGate  
  1x 1G gate: graftGate
  Router: 4 EMPTY ports (lan2-5)
  MikroTik: 2x SFP+ (1→fiber, 1→?)
  Latency: 0.1-0.4ms copper, 0.9ms fiber, 1.8-8ms WiFi
  BLE: 5 radios discoverable

STEP 1: Map which MikroTik port each gate is on (need MikroTik password)
STEP 2: Wire eastGate eno1 (spare) → router lan2 (redundant path)
STEP 3: MEASURE — did latency change? New info → re-plan
STEP 4: Wire ironGate spare NIC → router lan3 (second redundant)
STEP 5: Move 2.5G switch inline for sporeGate+blueGate+graftGate
STEP 6: MEASURE — re-plan
STEP 7: Enable BLE mesh scanning on all gates (proximity gossip)
STEP 8: Move graftGate M4 to House 2 via JetStream
STEP 9: MEASURE — fiber latency with M4 on other side

Each step: swap cable → measure → eat new info → re-plan if needed
